public_answer_use: Evaluation only after receiving each model response. Never copied into messages, config, or prompt variant; no answer constructed by inference code.

metric_check.evaluation_basis: P312446:85 valid questions, denominator includes format errors; P898100:68 supported questions; public answer reason confirms 68/85=80%.

A.prediction: More output budget may allow a final JSON answer; correctness may still fail if metric interpretation remains wrong. If 1024 is exhausted, record failure and do not raise budget again.

B.single_change: Append exactly the separately saved generic sentence to system message
B.prediction: Explicitly distinguishing numerator, denominator and count/percentage may reduce D01 misinterpretation; may have no effect and must not cause unsupported guesses on other dev tasks.

comparison_scope: A vs previous thinking256; B vs previous nonthinking256. A vs B changes multiple factors, no single-factor causal attribution.
selection_rule: Qualify only if exact answer/citations JSON schema, answer matches public answer and visible text, citation IDs belong to actual input, and cited content is sufficient. Select B if B qualifies (also if both qualify); select A only if A qualifies and B does not; if neither qualifies, select B as an unvalidated low-budget candidate and explicitly report no improvement.
transfer: Use selected setting unchanged on D02, D03, D04 E once each, without per-case prompt tuning.
stop_conditions: Sixth call reserved only for a concrete technical failure with a identified/remedied cause; link retry to failed record.
Wrong answers, malformed model JSON and length-limited model output are not technical retry grounds.
No further budget increase after A, even if length-limited.
No formal evaluation, cloud service, source prompt changes, commit or push.
evaluation_dimensions: complete exact answer/citations JSON with string answer and list of string citations
answer agrees with public dev answer and visible text
citation text semantically sufficient (separate from ID existence)
client time, generated tokens, finish reason and failure reason
insufficient_answer_rule: For D02, public evidence_ids is empty because the answer is insufficient; check actual citations as inspection sources, especially noncollected GPU fields, rather than treating the empty gold list as a mandate for zero citations.
runtime: Same Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0, llama.cpp b11429, CPU, ctx2048, threads4, parallel1, reasoning off default; request kwargs enables A; empty slot cache before each call.
